function.name: maelle_read_file
function.description: Read a text file from Maelle's server. This tool runs on the agent's machine, not the user's. Pass an absolute path.

path.description: Absolute path of the file on Maelle's server

function.name: maelle_list_dir
function.description: List the entries of a directory on Maelle's server. This tool runs on the agent's machine, not the user's.

path.description: Absolute path of the directory on Maelle's server

function.name: maelle_run_command
function.description: Run a shell command on Maelle's server (with full sudo access). Use this for anything read_file/list_dir cannot do. Returns the exit code plus combined stdout/stderr. Commands time out after 60 seconds unless timeout_seconds says otherwise.

function.name: maelle_web_search
function.description: Search the public web from Maelle's server via SearXNG. Returns results as title, URL and snippet. Use this when the answer depends on fresh or external facts instead of guessing.

function.name: maelle_web_fetch
function.description: Fetch an http(s) URL from Maelle's server and return its text. HTML pages are stripped down to readable text. JavaScript-rendered pages won't show their dynamic content.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL to fetch
